summary: Backend-only verification of SAMSON Sprint 4 signup fix on Emergent preview. All 13 backend tests pass (100%). Verified: register happy path, exact duplicate-email detail 'Email already registered', whitespace/case normalization + dedupe, invalid-email 422 (Pydantic mentions 'valid email' / '@-sign'), missing-password 422, bad/empty referral silent-ignore, login regression, ad-reward 410 compliance regression, beta bug-reports 201 regression, backend log format 'auth.register endpoint=/api/auth/register status=<code> ... reason=<code>' present in backend.err.log, and password NEVER appears in logs.
critical_code_review_comments: models/user.py: UserCreate.password has no min_length constraint — a 2-char password ('12') is accepted (200). Mobile client's 6-char check is the only enforcement. Consider adding server-side min_length=6 or 8 on UserCreate.password so a legacy/malicious client can't create weak-password accounts.

routes/auth.py login() normalizes email with .lower() but NOT .strip(); a login attempt with leading/trailing whitespace on email will 401 even though register normalizes both. Minor UX/consistency gap.
routes/auth.py: 'New user registered:' plus the new '_log(...)' both emit a log line per register — slightly redundant. Consider consolidating to a single structured log.

The register endpoint returns access_token/refresh_token in the body AND httpOnly cookies — fine for web+mobile, but be aware refresh_token in body defeats the httpOnly hardening if a mobile bug later logs the body.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@vara.com / vara_admin_2026 — used only for /api/auth/login to obtain a token for the ad-reward 410 regression check. Admin user was NOT modified/deleted. All test users are TEST_ prefixed with random UUIDs.
seed_data_creation: Created ~9 TEST_ prefixed users during this run (all with random UUID emails). No cleanup performed — safe to leave in vara_db as they don't collide.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_auth_signup_fix.py is the regression suite for the signup-copy fix + related regressions (login, ad-reward 410, beta bug-reports 201). Backend log format assertion reads /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log (Python logging → stderr) with a retry loop. NOTE: backend lowercases email before logging — always compare with .lower(). Beta bug-report POST requires full schema: name, email, device_model, android_version, app_screen, severity, what_happened.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is verification of an already-applied fix, not a bug investigation. The original P0/P1 mobile masking of backend detail strings is a mobile-side fix pending EAS rebuild (out of scope for backend testing). Backend behavior verified to expose the exact detail strings the mobile client keys off of.
